section_goal: State missing production trace, wall-clock latency, operator workload, and official benchmark gaps.

limitations_outline.paragraph_goal: State that current trace evidence is fixture, bridge, span, OTLP, and import evidence, not production telemetry or live deployment evidence.
future_work: Collect reviewed real or semi-real multi-step power-agent traces before any production-safety claim.

limitations_outline.paragraph_goal: State that the performance profile uses a field-check latency proxy and does not measure wall-clock latency.
future_work: Measure wall-clock latency with runtime instrumentation before reporting speed claims.

limitations_outline.paragraph_goal: State that the current artifact does not support real operator workload reduction because there is no operator-time or human-study evidence.
excluded_claims: reduces real human workload without operator-time evidence
future_work: Run operator-time or reviewer-burden studies before any real workload-reduction claim.

limitations_outline.paragraph_goal: State that AgentDojo-style and semi-real bridge fixtures are expressibility evidence, not official benchmark superiority.
future_work: Run official external benchmarks and pre-register comparison rules before any superiority claim.
